While walking through the academy, I spotted a familiar figure.
...Class should be in session right now, though...

My vocal coach puts their heart into teaching me, after all.
I've gotta respond to that sincerity in kind.

And then the buildings reflecting the sky blue.
Each and every one of them looks like an audience member waving a penlight!

It's just, it needs to be more... yeah! Mm, whatever.
Let's head to the next spot!

Was what she was looking for really that vague and uncertain...?
Unable to imagine what was going through her mind, all I could do was follow along.
No matter what must be sacrificed, the resolve of strength to see it through!

Putting me on the spot like that's tough, y'know.
I don't really get it myself.

Poking her tongue out, Mr. C.B.
lightly slipped right past the guidance counselor.

Mr. C.B. is always true to herself. What kind of place could it be
that would actually get her in the right mood...?

The rooftop... It felt open with the vast blue sky spread out.
Yet, surrounded by chain-link fences, it didn't quite feel like a stage—
Looks like I can finally head back now—
Besides... yeah, look at this scenery!

Plus, it comes with a spotlight from the sun!
See? This is the ultimate stage!

Singing lessons.
I just really wasn't feeling it inside a classroom, though.

I got permission from the teacher,
and now I'm looking for a nice spot to practice.
Yeah, singing in a wide-open space feels great, but...
To their true, wholehearted sincerity, I mean.
Hmm, maybe here?

I mean, sure, it's not like I can't sing in a classroom, but...
Bottom line, I just didn't want to. It felt dishonest.

Uh-oh, it's the guidance counselor...
Sorry! Cover for me and explain!
I don't mind telling you, but... you sure take an interest in strange things, don't you?
Yeah, nice! This is the place!

Acting true to herself for the sake of giving her best performance—
I couldn't help but think that was quintessentially Mr. C.B.
Hey! What student is out on the rooftop during class hours?!

Take a look over there yourself.
This vast stage stretching out as far as the eye can see.

Oh, hey there.
Fancy meeting you here.
Mmm~ The breeze feels great.

Breaking through the wind, I dash ahead~♪
My racing heartbeat won't ever stooop~♪

...Hrmm~ Not quite this spot either, huh.
Doesn't feel any different from singing in the classroom.
...At the speed of light, this rushing impulse is...

Hearing her words made it feel as though a stage had manifested right before my eyes.
Seeing her sing so freely on it seemed to prove her point—

Hehe, right?
...Yeah, all right. Think I can respond to them properly now?
